summary: Catalogued the models in everyday use with real limits, tools and reasoning: openai-codex (gpt-5-codex, gpt-5.1/-codex/-mini/-max, gpt-5.2/-codex, gpt-5.3-codex, gpt-5.4/-mini; 272k/128k), openai (gpt-5, gpt-5-mini, gpt-5-codex, gpt-5.1/-codex/-max, gpt-5.2-codex, gpt-5.3-codex, gpt-5.4/-mini, o3, o4-mini), anthropic (claude-opus-5-5, opus-5, opus-4-8, opus-4-7, opus-4-6, sonnet-5-5, sonnet-5, haiku-5-5 with adaptive effort levels; haiku-4-5 tools without effort) and google (gemini-2.5-pro, 2.5-flash-lite, 3-pro-preview, 3.1-pro-preview, 3-flash-preview). An explicit connection to an uncatalogued model no longer silently drops tools: tools and the wire's reasoning default are kept (images/files/structured output stay conservative), while an effort is only advertised and sent for catalogued or user-declared levels; the conservative 32768/4096 window stays. Profiles that name no model use a provider default (openai-codex/openai gpt-5.4, anthropic claude-opus-4-6, google gemini-2.5-pro). Anthropic and Gemini effort validation reads the catalog instead of one hard-coded model; Gemini 3 is sent thinkingLevel, 2.5 keeps thinkingBudget.
